title: Canada Near Me — Sam Barton whisky in France

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Optional city names, one per line. Empty means French cities are loaded automatically.

minPopulation.title: Minimum city population
minPopulation.description: Minimum population when cities are loaded automatically.

maxCities.title: Maximum cities
maxCities.description: Maximum number of cities checked during one run.

maxStoresPerCityToCheck.title: Stores checked per city
maxStoresPerCityToCheck.description: Maximum candidate stores tested before the city is skipped.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Required because Courses U blocks direct Apify datacenter requests.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Optional Apify Proxy groups separated by commas. Leave empty for automatic proxy rotation; use RESIDENTIAL if ordinary proxies remain blocked.
